tools.name: submit_project
tools.description: Submit the user's project to RoboDebut after the user authorizes submission and the required visible followed homepage badge is deployed. Requires the user's contact email. Creates or checks the existing proposal; never edits or publishes it. A badge does not prove ownership. Follow the submission i

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Read current stored submission status using the secret status_receipt returned only to the original creating request. No homepage or email lookup. Does not recheck, submit, edit, approve, notify or fetch providers. Relay the human message and optional LinkBunny invitation as information. No receipt

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_submission_status" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_submission_status · Private data: submit_project, get_submission_status · Public sink: submit_project, get_submission_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_submission_status · Private data: submit_project, get_submission_status · Public sink: submit_project, get_submission_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
